Objective: Measure the expensive operations accepted SXN-01 and speed it up, and keep it up accurate bytes. Complete search Puzzle It doesn't start; everything targets synthetic. Old source, binary and seals do not change.

Measure separately MT/hex, stretch100000, formatting/D2H, GPU public-key, host parsing four SHA256d/scalar-add/filter. For device-phase out CUDA events, for host/end-to-end — UTC wall and perf_counter. Profile not to replace Instructions counting or old bandwidth estimation.

Permissible optimizations: specialization SHA256 for two fixed blocks, precalculation padding schedule/constant, GPU integer intrinsics, independent chains in one stream, start parameters/portions, reduction of overhead costs. Exactly 100000 SHA256 rounds and past 16 MT draw %255 They're still there.

Each measured variant is first compared byte with the accepted binary hashlib/affine and native preserved cases uint32, zero bytes, different number of rounds/sizing and size not multiples of the block. Synthetic complete pipeline: four-way receive/change × i−1/i for i=50.

Comparisons at the same size, change order baseline/optimized, Show the scatter and selected parameters. Declined options and errors save. Quick short measurements are needed for selection; the result is taken in full stretch100000. Extrapolation uint32 Measurement of current implementation/Cars, no warranty Multi-day work or proof of impossibility of further optimization.
